name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'open the door' unconditionally and without a preference cue, so a hard Existence(door_open) is needed; the candidate only has the rule NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open), leaving FINAL_STATES empty and nothing requiring the door to open. Add a hard Existence(door_open). The prohibition side is fine: since key_lost is defined only when door_open is false, NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures 'never drop the key while the door is still closed'.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a 'never both' restriction, and NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) hard captures it — the key may not be dropped while the door is still closed (key_lost already embeds 'door still closed') and the door may not be opened once such a drop happened. No goal is commanded unconditionally, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

machine:
